_meta.note: SAMPLE / illustrative data. These theses are placeholders for well-known tickers so the system is runnable after cloning. Replace with your own before using for real.

VOO.bull_case: Broad, low-cost exposure to the 500 largest US companies; the passive core the rest of the portfolio is measured against.
VOO.bear_case: Concentrated in US mega-cap technology at the top of the index, so a rotation out of large-cap tech drags the whole position.

VWRP.bull_case: Single-line global diversification across developed and emerging markets; the accumulating structure is capital-efficient inside an ISA.
VWRP.bear_case: Still roughly 60% US by weight, so the global label overstates the diversification benefit during a US drawdown.

AAPL.bull_case: Large, sticky installed base with a growing high-margin services line layered on top of hardware.
AAPL.bear_case: Hardware upgrade cycles are lengthening and regulatory pressure on the App Store threatens services economics.

MSFT.bull_case: Enterprise software franchise with cloud (Azure) and AI monetisation compounding on top of durable recurring revenue.
MSFT.bear_case: Heavy AI-infrastructure capital spending compresses free cash flow if enterprise AI adoption is slower than guided.

GOOGL.bull_case: Dominant search advertising funds cloud growth and AI investment; multiple optionality layers (Cloud, Waymo).
GOOGL.bear_case: Antitrust remedies and AI-driven changes to search behaviour threaten the core advertising economics.

AMZN.bull_case: Cloud (AWS) re-acceleration plus a fast-growing advertising business and improving retail margins.
AMZN.bear_case: Very large AI-infrastructure capex weighs on free cash flow and any AWS deceleration compresses the multiple.

NVDA.bull_case: The default supplier of accelerated-computing hardware and software (CUDA) at the centre of the AI build-out.
NVDA.bear_case: A high bar of expectations; any pause in hyperscaler AI spending or rising competition compresses a stretched multiple.

AMD.bull_case: Credible second source for data-centre AI GPUs and CPUs, taking share as customers diversify supply.
AMD.bear_case: A distant number two with a less mature software ecosystem; export controls and cyclicality add risk.

PLTR.bull_case: Fast commercial growth on its AI platform with a differentiated data-integration moat and government backlog.
PLTR.bear_case: Extreme valuation leaves no margin for error; any deceleration in commercial growth resets the multiple hard.

RIVN.bull_case: Differentiated product and a commercial-van relationship provide a path to scale if unit economics improve.
RIVN.bear_case: Pre-profit and cash-burning; needs to reach positive gross margin before capital markets tighten.
